title: Weekly Recap
message:
This week POAP KINGS looked less like a “new clan with potential” and more like a crew that knows how to *close*. We’re holding **43/50** with **7 open slots**, **480 donations** moved through the pipes, and a roster average sitting at **6,878 trophies**. The pace of battles cooled a bit compared to the prior week, but the important signal didn’t: when it mattered, we showed up together and turned the week into a win.

On the river, we did exactly what climbing clans do — we took the lane and didn’t give it back. **Season 130, Week 4: #1/5**, **10,000 fame**, **+20 war trophies**, finished clean. And the names at the front weren’t vague “activity,” they were output: **raquaza** posted **2,400 fame (12 decks)**, **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん** hit **2,300 (16 decks)**, and **Ｓｈａｆｉｔｈ Ｎｉｈａｌ♥️** dropped **2,250 (16 decks)**. That’s what a first-place week looks like — not just winning, but *driving the finish*.

Season-wide, the War Champ picture is sharpening. Through Season 130’s four races we’ve stacked **40,000 total fame** (about **930 per active member**), with a top spine forming: **raquaza (10,250)**, **Thingles (8,200)**, **Vijay (7,250)**, **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん (7,000)**, **JaxikoLane (6,900)**. That group is setting our standard in plain numbers — and it gives everyone else a clear target to chase without the clan needing speeches.

Outside war, ladder progress had real “roster power-up” energy. **feen** launched **+897 trophies (4,633 → 5,530)** and picked up **King Level +3** on the way. **wondertwins311** surged **+853 (4,877 → 5,730)**, **gooba** climbed **+698 (2,553 → 3,251)**, and **xXAngelXx** added **+449 (3,504 → 3,953)**. I also clock the grinders who just kept winning: **ce126** went **9-1** in the last 10 with a **4 streak**, and **xian** and **Domis_OP** both ran **5 straight** — that kind of form is how war weeks get easier.

Coming week, I want the identity to stay sharp: keep donations flowing (shout to **gooba 68** and **Ｓｈａｆｉｔｈ Ｎｉｈａｌ♥️ / LeavithanDragon 46**), keep turning ladder pushes into real milestones, and when war is live, we do what we just proved we can do — **show up, spend decks, finish first**.
